measure.measure_definition: Measured value: absolute number of monthly headache days, defined as calendar days with headache lasting at least 4 h with moderate or greater intensity or any headache requiring acute migraine medication.; Participants; Standardized headache diary; monthly headache days assessed at baseline and month 6 after treatment. MHD counted as calendar days meeting the headache definition.; MHD definition includes headache lasting ≥4 h with moderate or greater intensity, or any headache requiring acute migraine medication. Absolute monthly count; no imputation.

Categorical status: responder, defined as ≥50% reduction in monthly headache days from baseline at month 6.; Participants; Standardized headache diary; MHD at baseline and month 6 used to classify participants as responders or non-responders.; Responder = ≥50% reduction in MHD from baseline. Month 6 responder rate; per-protocol denominator.
measure.measure_name: At least 50% reduction in monthly headache days (MHD responder)

measure.measure_definition: Measured value: absolute number of monthly acute migraine medication days.; Participants; Standardized headache diary; monthly acute medication days assessed at baseline and month 6.; Days per month with acute migraine medication use; absolute monthly count; no imputation.

population.intervention: Ultrasound-guided proximal greater occipital nerve pulsed radiofrequency (GON-PRF) at the C2 level, unilateral, without concomitant local anesthetic or corticosteroid.
population.intervention_regimen: Per application: 360 s at 45 V, pulse frequency 5 Hz, pulse width 5 ms; electrode tip temperature maintained below 42 °C.; Single procedure session; unilateral treatment on the side with predominant headache symptoms; monitored for at least 1 h and discharged the same day if no complications occurred.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment allocation to unilateral GON-PRF and inclusion in the per-protocol analysis set.; Age 18–65 years; ICHD-3 episodic migraine (≥5 migraine attacks/month) or chronic migraine; inadequate response to preventive migraine therapies and either untreated or on a stable preventive regimen for at least 3 months; no active infection or bleeding disorder; no current pregnancy; no history of craniocervical surgery affecting the intervention site; randomized to unilateral ultrasound-guided proximal GON-PRF at C2; received allocated intervention; completed 6-month follow-up without major protocol deviations, additional migraine interventions, or incomplete outcome data. Excludes other primary headache disorders, secondary headache, recent interventional migraine procedure/botulinum toxin/non-pharmacological migraine treatment within 3 months, and participants lost to follow-up or excluded from per-protocol analysis.
population.population_time_frame: Follow-up from baseline to month 6; exact enrollment dates Not reported.

population.intervention: Ultrasound-guided proximal greater occipital nerve pulsed radiofrequency (GON-PRF) at the C2 level, bilateral, without concomitant local anesthetic or corticosteroid.
population.intervention_regimen: Per application: 360 s at 45 V, pulse frequency 5 Hz, pulse width 5 ms; electrode tip temperature maintained below 42 °C. Bilateral group received the same parameters contralaterally.; Single procedure session; bilateral treatment with the same procedure repeated contralaterally during the same session; monitored for at least 1 h and discharged the same day if no complications occurred.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment allocation to bilateral GON-PRF and inclusion in the per-protocol analysis set.; Age 18–65 years; ICHD-3 episodic migraine (≥5 migraine attacks/month) or chronic migraine; inadequate response to preventive migraine therapies and either untreated or on a stable preventive regimen for at least 3 months; no active infection or bleeding disorder; no current pregnancy; no history of craniocervical surgery affecting the intervention site; randomized to bilateral ultrasound-guided proximal GON-PRF at C2; received allocated intervention; completed 6-month follow-up without major protocol deviations, additional migraine interventions, or incomplete outcome data. Excludes other primary headache disorders, secondary headache, recent interventional migraine procedure/botulinum toxin/non-pharmacological migraine treatment within 3 months, and participants lost to follow-up or excluded from per-protocol analysis.
population.population_time_frame: Follow-up from baseline to month 6; exact enrollment dates Not reported.

population.intervention: Ultrasound-guided proximal (C2) greater occipital nerve pulsed radiofrequency (GON-PRF), unilateral or bilateral according to allocation; no medications injected during the PRF procedure.
population.intervention_regimen: Per application: 45 V, 5 Hz, 5 ms pulse width for 360 seconds; electrode tip temperature not exceeding 42 °C.; PRF application for 360 seconds per treated side; bilateral treatment repeats the same procedure contralaterally. Post-procedure observation for at least 1 hour before discharge.
population.population_definition: All 187 participants randomized in the published CONSORT flow diagram: 91 unilateral and 96 bilateral GON-PRF. The published report screened 268 and retained 166 in the per-protocol analysis (78 unilateral, 88 bilateral). This parent population is defined by the published participant flow.
population.population_time_frame: Enrollment start 2024-12-18 (actual); primary completion 2026-04-01 (actual); study completion 2026-05-01 (actual); outcome follow-up from baseline to 6 months after treatment.
